            r1 = max(r for r,c in cells)
            c0 = min(c for r,c in cells)
            c1 = max(c for r,c in cells)

            # Marker colors lie on a corner-to-interior diagonal.
            best = None
            for cr, cc, dr, dc in (
                (r0,c0,1,1), (r0,c1,1,-1),

                out[r][c] = palette[d % len(palette)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = max((v for v in counts if v != background), key=lambda v: counts[v])

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for r0 in range(h):
        for c0 in range(w):
            if grid[r0][c0] == wall or (r0, c0) in seen:
                continue

            q = deque([(r0, c0)])
            seen.add((r0, c0))
            cells = []

            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                cells.append((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1, c), (r+1, c), (r, c-1), (r, c+1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                        grid[nr][nc] != wall and (nr, nc) not in seen):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            top = min(r for r, c in cells)
            bottom = max(r for r, c in cells)
            left = min(c for r, c in cells)
            right = max(c for r, c in cells)

            markers = {}
            for r, c in cells:
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color != background and color != wall:
                    depth = min(r-top, bottom-r, c-left, right-c)
                    markers[depth] = color

            if not markers:
                continue

            period = max(markers) + 1
            palette = [markers.get(d, background) for d in range(period)]

            for r, c in cells:
                depth = min(r-top, bottom-r, c-left, right-c)
                out[r][c] = palette[depth % period]

    return out
